question: A circle is inscribed in a ΔABC having sides AB = 16 cm, BC = 20 cm and AC = 24 cm, and side AB, BC and AC touches circle at D, E and F, respectively. The measure of AD is:
solution: **Given:** A circle is inscribed in a ΔABC having sides AB = 16 cm, BC = 20 cm and AC = 24 cm Side AB, BC and AC touch circle at D, E and F **Concept used:** When two tangent is drawn from same point on the circle then the length of the both of the chord will be same **Calculation:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17dbdb8c9b52a644f3be7ecaaec2a35e6d83f8eb1fc6ba9501feb23a99e05285.png] As from point A two tangent is drawn on the circle ⇒ AD = AF = a Similarly, From point B two tangent is drawn on the circle ⇒ BD = BE = b
